fields.name: classes
fields.label: Options
fields.description: Only pick options that differ from the default look (full header, centred, filled highlight, headline with info tooltip). Pick at most one feature text option.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: Optional heading shown above the table (use Heading 2 or 3)

fields.name: products
fields.label: Products
fields.description: Product ids from the products sheet, comma separated, in column order, e.g. premium-security, premium-vpn, ultimate

fields.name: highlight
fields.label: Highlighted Product
fields.description: Product id(s) to highlight, e.g. ultimate

fields.name: labels
fields.label: Product Labels
fields.description: Optional pills above product names as id: text, comma separated, e.g. ultimate: Best value

fields.name: features
fields.label: Features
fields.description: Feature ids in row order, one per line or comma separated. Use category: <id> for a whole category, <prefix>* for a group, and <id> (New, icon) for a badge and/or the feature icon.

fields.name: cta
fields.label: Buttons
fields.description: Optional: one link per product, in product order. Products without a link use their sheet URL with the first link's label.

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note
fields.description: Optional small print under the table, e.g. the asterisk note

fields.name: data
fields.label: Data Source
fields.description: Optional workbook path. Defaults to /{locale}/comparison/data (or the comparison-data page metadata). {locale} is replaced by the page locale, with fallback to /en.
